'''2008 New York State Championship Bill Kafer LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Decks like Jesus
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
